environment_notes.h3_computed_font: 21.06px — no stylesheet rule sets h3's font-size, so the browser's 1.17em default applies; its 1.6em top margin is 33.7px, not the 28.8px a 1rem assumption gives
environment_notes.contact_list_note: ul.contact-list is a multi-column container (columns: 2), an independent formatting context, so the last li's 10px margin-bottom stays inside the ul box; the before gap measured at the box level is 0px, where the baseline note's 'about 10px' described the li margin that a non-column list would have collapsed outward

acceptance_case.description: act-now.html: h2 'Writing a letter to the editor' — gap above = contact list box bottom to h2 top; gap below = h2 bottom to the Sentry h3 top. The heading must sit visibly closer to the Sentry block it introduces than to the legislator contact rows above it.
acceptance_case.verdict: passes at all three widths: 44px above vs 33.7px below after, against 0px above vs 33.7px below before — the heading moved off the rows it does not belong to and onto the block it introduces
